title: Disney Princesses Unite for a Magical Concert — and You Can Watch Free!
summary:
Imagine hearing the real voices of your favorite Disney princesses all in one place! That's exactly what happened at Disneyland. For a special TV show called Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration, the original singers came together to perform. Jodi Benson, the voice of Ariel from The Little Mermaid, was there. So was Paige O'Hara, who sang as Belle in Beauty and the Beast. Auli'i Cravalho, the voice of Moana, and Lea Salonga, who sang for Jasmine in Aladdin, also joined in. Even Brandy, who played Cinderella in a movie, and Halle Bailey, the new Ariel, performed.

The concert was filmed at Disneyland in California. It will be on TV on Sunday, August 16, at 8 p.m. You can watch it on ABC, Disney Channel, or Freeform. If you have Disney+, you can stream it there too.

But what if you don't have cable? No problem! There are ways to watch for free. Some streaming services like DirecTV, Fubo, and Hulu + Live TV offer free trials. You can sign up, watch the concert, and then cancel before the trial ends. That's a pretty sweet deal.

So grab some popcorn, put on your favorite princess dress (or not), and get ready to sing along. It's a royal celebration you won't want to miss!
why_it_matters: You can enjoy live TV events without cable by asking a grown-up to help you try a free streaming trial, but you need to remember to cancel it before paying.
